PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Erin can't be at row 4, column 4; row 3, column 5: in each case Celeste would have nowhere left to go. Suppose Celeste were at row 4, column 2: then Bruno would have nowhere left to go. So Celeste can't be there. Testing the remaining squares the same way rules out a few more. So Erin (E) must be at row 1, column 5. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: Suppose Gwen were at row 4, column 8: then Celeste would have nowhere left to go. So Gwen can't be there. Suppose Gwen were at row 3, column 8: then the general clue ("There were exactly two people on a carpet.") could not be true. So Gwen can't be there. Testing the remaining squares the same way rules out a few more. So Gwen (G) must be at row 3, column 7. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: Suppose Flora were at row 8, column 1: then the general clue ("There were exactly two people on a carpet.") could not be true. So Flora can't be there. Suppose Flora were at row 8, column 8: then Vernon would have nowhere left to go. So Flora can't be there. Testing the remaining squares the same way rules out a few more. So Flora (F) must be at row 7, column 8. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: Suppose Bruno were at row 2, column 2: then Vernon would have nowhere left to go. So Bruno can't be there. So Bruno (B) must be at row 5, column 2. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: Using the general clue ("There were exactly two people on a carpet."), some squares are ruled out for Albert. So Albert (A) must be at row 8, column 3. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Celeste that fits her clue ("She was sitting in a chair in the Kitchen."). So Celeste (C) must be at row 4, column 1. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_7_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Vernon. So Vernon (the victim) must be at row 2, column 4. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_8_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Desmond that fits his clue ("He was not in the Ballroom."). So Desmond (D) must be at row 6, column 6. Cross out his row and column. Erin is the only person in the Hall with Vernon, so Erin is the murderer!
